description: This file defines Express.js routes for various API endpoints in a backend service. It includes route handlers for health checks, trending shows, categorized show lists, show info retrieval, and static assets like banners and videos. It also sets up sub-routes for featured content and banner images, and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Health endpoint that checks the service's health status via healthController.check.

methods.name: router.get('/api/trending')
methods.description: Returns a list of trending shows via showsController.trending.

methods.name: router.get('/api/continue_watching')
methods.description: Returns user's continue watching list via showsController.continueWatching.

methods.name: router.get('/api/action')
methods.description: Gets action genre shows via showsController.action.

methods.name: router.get('/api/family')
methods.description: Gets family genre shows via showsController.family.

methods.name: router.get('/api/comedy')
methods.description: Gets comedy genre shows via showsController.comedy.

methods.name: router.get('/api/horror')
methods.description: Gets horror genre shows via showsController.horror.

methods.name: router.get('/api/drama')
methods.description: Gets drama genre shows via showsController.drama.

methods.name: router.get('/api/play')
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL to a demo video, dynamically constructed from request data.

methods.name: router.use('/api/featured')
methods.description: Mounts the featured route which returns a random featured item.

methods.name: router.use('/api/banner')
methods.description: Mounts the banner route which provides up to five random banner image URLs.

methods.name: router.get('/api/info/:id?')
methods.description: Fetches detailed show info by id or via query parameter, using infoController.get.

methods.name: router.get('/api/:category')
methods.description: Generic endpoint to fetch shows by category, handled by showsController.getByCategory.
